subject: wo-exp-pr
title: WO.EXP.PR.------DYM.SPT.
description: Second diagram on page 135 (ALT(FT)II-29), paired with T-SC × INT above. Where the first diagram crosses theoretical-science with intention, this one names what world-expansion-principle meets when dynamic-spiritualism is the working partner: WO-EXP-PR (world expansion principle) crossed with DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism). WO-EXP-PR sits at the bottom-left with the subject-arrow; DYM-SPT at top-left and CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis) at upper-right. EXB-H-OR (establishing high order) sits at the left below DYM-SPT. TR-INFO (trans-information) sits centrally above; INFO-DE(B) (information degrees) below it and APL-DT (application dictates) anchoring the upper-right. PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) sits at center-right. RE-CONT (recontinuance) sits centrally below with AF-POST (affinity postulation) at lower-center and PRI-INFO (principle information) at the bottom-right. Structural argument: when world-expansion-principle is crossed with dynamic-spiritualism, three lines leave the vertical main line. The top one runs to CULT-AF-B, with EXB-H-OR branching from it and TR-INFO from the EXB-H-OR line. The middle one runs to PROJ-DY, with INFO-DE(B) branching from it and APL-DT from the INFO-DE(B) line. The lowest runs to AF-POST, with RE-CONT branching from it and PRI-INFO from the RE-CONT line.
